changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Organization') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Organization]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Accepted] [bit] NULL, [AcceptedBy] [int] NULL, [DateAccepted] [datetime] NULL, [AdministratorEmail] [varchar](250) NULL, [OrganizationTypeID] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Organization_OrganizationType] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Organization_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Organization] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Organization_OrganizationType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Organization] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Organization_OrganizationType] FOREIGN KEY([OrganizationTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[OrganizationType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Organization] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Organization_OrganizationType] END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Organization_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[Organization] AFTER DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON delete Asset where Object = 'Organization' and ObjectID in (select ID from deleted) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Organization_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Organization] AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [dbo].[Asset] ([AssetTypeID],[State],SourceID,[Object],[ObjectID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedOn],[UpdatedBy]) SELECT T.ID, 1, O.ID, 'Organization', O.ID, getutcdate(), 0, getutcdate(), 0 FROM inserted O inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'OrganizationType' and T.ObjectID = O.OrganizationTypeID; END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Organization_AfterUpdate] ON [dbo].[Organization] AFTER UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON update T set T.UpdatedBy = 0, T.UpdatedOn = getutcdate() from Asset T inner join inserted S on T.Object = 'Organization' and T.ObjectID = S.ID END
